name: Arazaki Tetsuya
source:
The Master of the Miduki House, also one of the old elite families.

[spoiler]Tetsuya is the mastermind behind all the serial killings because of the pact with Saki who collected the bodies and blood for him to perform the resurrection of his sister.[/spoiler]
